thread:
maria: Heads-up — noticed about a ~22% drop in MQLs attributed to the webinar landing page in the last 48h vs the previous week. Dashboard shows 1,482 -> 1,165. anyone else seeing this?

alex: Yeah I noticed the same trend this morning. Thought it was a traffic dip but overall sessions look flat. :thinking_face:

sam: Quick thought — we pushed a GA tag update 2 days ago, could have changed sampling/utm parsing. will check.

olivia: @maria can you paste the dashboard link or screenshot?

maria: link: https://dash.redwood.com/marketing/kpis?panel=mqls — filter = segment: "webinar-lp", cohort by utm_source. If you look at Mar14-16 window the 'spring_launch' segment drops.

alex: I pulled raw event counts for /webinar-landing. here's the query I ran: ```SELECT utm_campaign, count(*) FROM events WHERE page='/webinar-landing' AND ts >= '2026-03-14' AND ts < '2026-03-17' GROUP BY utm_campaign``` — 'spring_launch' is lower than expected.

engbot: analytics-bot: event-ingest backfill job queued for 2026-03-14..2026-03-16 (job id: jb-4425).

sam: Also saw a CRM dedupe rule change deployed Mar 15 — leads with same email but different utm now merge and inherit the earlier campaign. That would reduce dashboard-attributed MQL counts but CRM lead table still contains the records.

olivia: We should overlay CRM.created_at vs event.ts to confirm origin. I can run that join and export a sample.

maria: Priorities: 1) verify UTM mapping + GA tag 2) check CRM merge/dedupe effects 3) run backfill if ingest gap. Who can own 2 & 3?

sam: I'll own the CRM dedupe check (sam). ETA EOD today.

alex: I'll validate UTM mapping and raw event count (alex). ETA 2pm.

engops: engops: I can fast-track the backfill if analytics-team approves, will queue next maintenance slot.

maria: Thanks. Also add as agenda item for Fri KPI review — it's skewing our week-over-week.

olivia: Added to Fri 11:00 KPI review. I'll prepare before/after viz and a short note for the deck.

sam: :thumbsup: I'll post CRM dedupe findings back here when done.

alex: FYI — if backfill goes through expect an MQL bump Friday morning. Heads-up for Sales.

maria: Noted — cc @sales-team. Any risks to attributed revenue metrics?

engbot: analytics-bot: backfill job completed (jb-4425). 2,327 events backfilled. delta: +18% to 'spring_launch' segment.

maria: Nice — initial dashboard refresh shows +16% MQLs for the affected window. Monitoring for next 24-72h then we'll reconcile with CRM. I'll update SLA metrics if stabilizes.

olivia: Follow-up note: open a postmortem if gap >10% persists after 48h. Assign to @maria and @sam.

sam: ack.

maria: Thanks everyone. Will summarize findings in Friday KPI readout and include recommended fixes (UTM validation in deploy checklist + revert risky dedupe rule).
